title: APC update manifest
description: Signed update manifest (framework standard apc-update/1.0, decisions U-16, X-07, L-09). Produced by `apc release manifest` / `apc release sign`, fetched by the plugin's ApcUpdateFlow. The signature is Ed25519 over the canonical JSON (apc-canon/1: keys sorted by UTF-8 bytes, no whitespace, integers only, see common/apc/ApcCanonicalJson.h) of this document WITHOUT the "signature" member. The signing key is the dedicated UPDATE key - never the license key; the plugin embeds only its public key. Authenticode / notarization of the installer itself are OS-level and additional. All numbers in this document MUST be integers (floats are rejected by the verifiers).

product.description: Must equal the product identifier compiled into the plugin; a manifest for another product is ignored.

min_supported.description: Oldest version still supported. Informational: older plugins keep working and are only told to update.

notes.description: Plain-text release notes shown to the user (max 16 KiB).

artifacts.description: Full installers (not patches), at most one per platform+kind.

kind.description: The updater only offers kind=installer. 'archive' (zip/tar.gz) is for manual download pages.

url.description: https:// URL, or a bare file name resolved next to the manifest URL. No whitespace or control characters.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the artifact file.

signature.description: Base64 (standard alphabet, padded) of the 64-byte Ed25519 signature.
